title: Paired re-analysis of the 0004/0005-K4 head-to-head: no-op baseline, failure-term attribution, agent-navigation vs object-manipulation decomposition
verdict: H1_BASELINE_INFLATION_REJECTED; H2_JEPA_WORSE_THAN_NOOP_REJECTED(binary, floor effect); H3_AGENT_NAV_DOMINATES_SUPPORTED; H4_OBJECT_MANIP_ALSO_BROKEN_SUPPORTED
headline: Same displacement budget, opposite progress sign: agent_disp paired diff CI contains 0 (-1.7 [-25.2,+22.7]) while agent_progress paired diff is +132.9 [+108.3,+157.9]. JEPA-WM's planner is statistically indistinguishable from doing nothing on task success, and significantly WORSE than no-op on the block sub-criterion.

criterion_correction.critical_note: state[:4] = [agent_x, agent_y, block_x, block_y] — the AGENT position shares the single 20px budget with the block. The task also requires the agent to reach the expert's agent position at goal_step.
criterion_correction.first_version_status: VOID by pre-declared gate R0 (>=0.98 required)
criterion_correction.correction_method: read env source; NOT tuned to data
criterion_correction.memory_note: prior project memory recorded 'pos_diff < 20' without the 4-dim joint detail; corrected

task_difficulty_audit.note: no task is inside tolerance at t=0; the apparent '32% already solved' is the no-op hit rate under the BLOCK-ONLY sub-criterion only

core_finding_same_effort_opposite_direct.interpretation: identical displacement budget, opposite sign of goal progress => planner has no idea which direction its actions move the agent; behavioural signature of ACTION_INSENSITIVE_PREDICTION

failure_term_attribution.note: JEPA grows the agent gap from median 123.3 at start to 182.3 at end

counterfactual_block_only.status: diagnostic decomposition ONLY, not an alternative benchmark, not comparable to published numbers
counterfactual_block_only.interpretation: where headroom exists, JEPA is significantly WORSE than doing nothing: it destroys 8 of the 16 tasks whose block pose no-op would have satisfied, and rescues none

nuance_do_not_overstate: LeWM block_progress mean +10.24 CI [-4.59,+24.71] contains 0. Its block-only advantage (0.60 vs no-op 0.32) comes mainly from fixing the angle and not destroying an already-good block pose, NOT from large positive block position progress. Do not describe LeWM as 'precisely pushing the object into place'.

relation_to_section_8.role: third independent evidence line for ACTION_INSENSITIVE_PREDICTION
relation_to_section_8.line_1: KW-LEWM-0005 §8 latent mobility / action leverage diagnostic
relation_to_section_8.line_3: this analysis: paired behavioural readout (same effort, opposite progress sign)

strengthens_0004: H1 rejected: no-op is 0/50 under the true criterion, LeWM significantly beats it (McNemar p=7.6e-6). KW-LEWM-0004's 0.36 is genuine goal-directed control, not a 'did not break it' score.
caveats: no-op baseline is ANALYTIC (final state == start state), not executed; ignores residual agent velocity at t=0. Upgrading to E2 requires 50 real zero-action rollouts.
post-hoc re-analysis of data collected for a different question; hypotheses fixed in script header before computation; evidence stays E1

H2 rejected on the binary metric due to a floor effect (no-op is 0/50, no headroom). The continuous-metric counterpart (jepa pos_progress CI excludes 0) is a pre-specified statistic with no fixed threshold and is NOT reported as H2 support.
single checkpoint, single seed, single task set; all correlations/differences are E1 exploratory, no causal claims
